title: This Could Get Ugly... Fast
description:
Activists stormed a church service, shove past worshippers, and then lectured Christians about the First Amendment... in a place of worship. Oh, yeah, and Don Lemon was there.

Here’s what the footage shows,  and why this isn’t “peaceful assembly,” it’s intimidation.
